## Checklist

- [ ] `pnpm typecheck`, `pnpm test` and `pnpm build` pass
- [ ] Tests cover the change
- [ ] A changeset is added (`pnpm changeset`) if the published package changes
- [ ] Docs are updated for user-facing changes
- [ ] No typed values, clipboard content or other personal data can leave the browser
